qualified_boundaries: exact source-digest binding for candidate observations
raw manuscript text anywhere in materialization input fails before persistence
entity/event candidates require valid anchored evidence and confidence floor
ASSERTED claims require stronger support than ALTERNATIVE/UNRESOLVED claims
CONTESTED evidence cannot materialize as ASSERTED
INFERRED ASSERTED claims require high confidence plus at least two evidence families
conflicting alternatives are preserved rather than silently resolved
duplicate compatible identities merge anchors/provenance without confidence summation
dangling evidence cannot enter canonical state
sparse evidence produces a sparse valid state rather than fabricated facts
final canonical state must pass STEP-001 validation
authority_limit: This qualification proves deterministic materialization admission and canonical-state validation. It does not prove the factual accuracy of any future NLP/LLM extractor, and it does not authorize manuscript revision or author-intent resolution.
